mapper.select: SELECT s.med_staff_id AS staff_id, m.name AS staff_name, m.id AS user_id, d.med_dept_name, s.role FROM med_staff s JOIN mem m ON s.mem_id = m.mem_id JOIN med_dept d ON s.med_dept_id = d.med_dept_id WHERE (s.role IN ('DOCTOR', 'NURSE', '의사', '간호사')) AND s.status = '재직' ORDER BY d.med_dept_name ASC, m.name ASC
SELECT med_dept_id, med_dept_name, dept_location, dept_phone_number FROM med_dept ORDER BY med_dept_name ASC

SELECT s.med_staff_id AS staff_id, s.role, m.name AS staff_name FROM med_staff s JOIN mem m ON s.mem_id = m.mem_id WHERE s.med_dept_id = #{medDeptId} AND (s.role = 'DOCTOR' OR s.role = '의사') AND s.status = '재직'

SELECT r.reservation_id, r.reservation_date, r.reservation_time, r.reservation_status, d.med_dept_name, m.name AS doctor_name FROM reservation r JOIN med_dept d ON r.med_dept_id = d.med_dept_id JOIN med_staff s ON r.doctor_id = s.med_staff_id JOIN mem m ON s.mem_id = m.mem_id WHERE r.mem_id = #{memId} ORDER BY r.reservation_date DESC, r.reservation_time DESC

SELECT r.reservation_id, r.reservation_date, r.reservation_time, r.visit_type, r.reservation_memo, r.reservation_status, m.name AS patient_name, m.phone_number AS patient_phone FROM reservation r JOIN mem m ON r.mem_id = m.mem_id WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY r.reservation_date ASC, r.reservation_time ASC
